              Block of flats evacuated in Bristol as fire unfolds

              Fire service at the scene as residents wait in the street

              News
              Sarah Lumley Multimedia Reporter
              Updated 18:19, 04 Oct 2026

              A block of flats was evacuated in Bristol city centre after a fire.

              Listen to audio version of this article
              Sponsored by
              0:00 / 1:33
              Instaread

              A number of fire service vehicles were seen on Sunday morning, October 4, on the A38 North Street in the Stokes Croft area, outside The Full Moon and Attic Bar, at around 11.10am.

              People were waiting outside in the street as Avon Fire and Rescue Service attended the incident, with hose reels deployed to put out the blaze.

              All residents were back in the building by early afternoon.

              We will keep you updated with our live blog below. Send us information or pictures if it is safe to do so here

              4th Oct14:00 BST

              All residents now back in building

              One woman who was evacuated from the block of flats said that all residents are now back indoors.

              She said: "Everyone is back in the flats now, as far as I'm aware.

              "The fire alarm started going off at 8:30 this morning and then again around 9:30, we were evacuating each time and then i think it went again around just after 10am which was when the fire brigade turned up.

              "We were outside for around an hour in total. No-one was hurt as far as I’m aware, and I can't see any visual damage to the building."

              Sarah Lumley
